completed_tasks.name: Resume session, discard stale Phase 07 HANDOFF.json artifact (repo had already moved past it)
Run /gsd-discuss-phase 8 — 4 gray areas discussed (Delete with references, Hide scope & visibility, Reorder interaction, Rename predefined names)

decisions.decision: isDefault no longer blocks rename/delete on predefined locations
decisions.rationale: LOC-01/LOC-03 require full control over predefined locations

decisions.decision: Renamed predefined locations fall out of LOCATION_KEYS translation and display as plain strings thereafter (same as custom locations) — no new i18n override mechanism
decisions.rationale: User chose simplicity over preserving translation via a separate display-name override

decisions.decision: hidden: boolean field applies to ALL locations (not just predefined)
decisions.rationale: User wants one consistent toggle rather than isDefault-gated behavior

decisions.decision: Hidden locations excluded from Add/Edit and Move/Split dropdowns, but stay visible in the Filter sheet
decisions.rationale: Existing stock in a hidden location must remain findable/filterable even though new assignment is blocked

decisions.decision: Delete-with-references dialog offers inline reassign-or-clear (not a manual block-until-resolved flow); active stock only, soft-deleted/Trash entries excluded from the count
decisions.rationale: Best UX per user; trashed items are already out of the active workflow

decisions.decision: No minimum-location floor — user can delete every location down to zero
decisions.rationale: "No location" (Other/null) is a built-in form option independent of the locations table

decisions.decision: New order: number field via db.version(6) (never edit v5 in place); existing locations get alphabetical initial order on upgrade so the migration is visually silent
decisions.rationale: Matches current orderBy('name') display exactly until user actually reorders

decisions.decision: Reorder UI: drag handle PLUS up/down move buttons; no drag/sortable library exists yet in package.json — left to researcher/planner to pick one
decisions.rationale: Touch drag alone is unreliable on mobile and has no accessible fallback; buttons cover both

decisions.decision: Rename/add blocked on case-insensitive name collision with existing locations; names stored exactly as typed (no title-casing, unlike catalog's D-02 convention)
decisions.rationale: Avoids two rows displaying the same name; locations are short user-picked labels, not the catalog naming convention
